_comment: The gas station the garage's Gas Station button drives to. station.kn5 and ground.bin are NOT in the repository: the
scene is cut out of the player's own Assetto Corsa install (Bannochbrae by Rainmaker, a Project Cars conversion)
with tools/StationScene (see docs/screens/gas-station.md for the command). Without them the station works all the
Positions are metres from the middle of the scene (under the track's gas station sound, by the shop, on the ground),
x and z; +z is towards the road. The canopy's two pump islands run along x at z = 2 and z = 10, a pump at each
end (x = -1.5 and 1.5); the car stops in the lane between them, its driver's door to the island at z = 2.
A car's heading follows the path.
arrive: the way in, off the road to the pump; the car rolls in at the first point and stops at the last.
leave: the way out, from the pump (its first point) back onto the road; the screen goes when the car is gone.
lookAtPump: where the driver looks while the tank fills, degrees from straight ahead, to the left positive.
sun: the key light's direction by day, towards the sun. lights: as a street's (see streets/pretville/street.json).
prices: a litre of gas, a litre of oil, a wash, the tow truck; left out, the base game's.
title: Tomwixon Garages
